part: TUOFENG 22 AWG solid tinned-copper wire, six colors
listing_status: Amazon title/variant checked; price and checkout stock not verified

part: BNTECHGO 22 AWG stranded tinned-copper silicone wire, ten colors
listing_status: Amazon title/variant checked; price and checkout stock not verified
notes: Manufacturer: 60 × 0.08 mm tinned-copper strands; about 1.7 mm insulated diameter. Allow at least 2 m total per build (1 m red and 1 m black); supplied holder/RCY/servo-extension leads additional. Keep motor power off breadboard and cut short after dry fit.

listing_status: Manufacturer/distributor fallback; no verified Amazon exact listing

listing_status: Manufacturer/distributor fallback; no verified Amazon exact listing
